_comment: Threat-feed registry for v0.8.0 Intel. Passive/defensive only. A feed whose license terms are uncertain for this deployment ships license_ok=false and enabled_default=false; an operator must opt it in explicitly. abuse.ch feeds (URLhaus/ThreatFox/MalwareBazaar/Feodo) now require a free Auth-Key header on some endpoints — set BLUETEAM_INTEL_ABUSECH_AUTHKEY and the service adds it; without a key those feeds stay disabled. All URLs are https and pass the SSRF guard before every fetch.

feeds.name: urlhaus
feeds.notes: Malicious URLs, updated frequently. May require abuse.ch Auth-Key.

feeds.name: threatfox
feeds.notes: Mixed IOC types (url/domain/ip/hash) with malware family. May require Auth-Key.

feeds.name: malwarebazaar
feeds.notes: SHA-256 of recent malware samples with signature. May require Auth-Key.

feeds.name: feodotracker
feeds.notes: Botnet C2 IP blocklist. Off by default; JSON shape mapped via threatfox_json.

feeds.name: cisa_kev
feeds.notes: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities. ADVISORY IOCs — reporting only, never matched against messages.

feeds.name: openphish
feeds.license: Community feed — free for non-commercial; commercial use needs a paid license
feeds.notes: DISABLED by default: license uncertain for commercial deployments. Operator must confirm terms and opt in.
